messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — eval-gate triggered for route /chat/completions (model: redwood-neo-13b, env: prod). safety_score spike detected (0.78). Auto-page sent to oncall.

pagerduty: PAGER: se_high_eval_gate_trip -> oncall@sana paged. Incident ID: PD-900123. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-900123

sana: ack @pagerduty — I'll take it. jumping in to triage now.

mike: noted, i'm pulling the recent eval diffs and the rerun logs. suspect prompt set drift?

jordan: seeing same on dashboards — safety metric jumped at 12:11:02 UTC across multiple customers, esp customer: acme-inc.

san a quick question: is this across all p95 latencies or just quality?

sana: this is quality-only (eval gate). latency looks normal.

manita: (typo) — anita: hmm, i've got the eval job output. a handful of recent prompts generated hallucinated policy-violating content. attaching sample below.

anita: ```{"prompt_id":"p-4432","input":"summarize internal strategy","output":"...sensitive financials..."}```

mike: thanks. i'm running a delta between model variants now. if it's a model regression we should fail open to the last known-good variant.

sana: agree. quick customer impact check — oncall-runbook: is there a way to see which requests hit the failing variant?

jordan: yes, route logs show variant=redwood-neo-13b:v12. I can query tokenized request counts. running: `SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE model_variant=\"redwood-neo-13b:v12\" AND ts > to_timestamp(4970001000);`

mike: results: ~1.2k requests in last 10m, spread across 3 customers (acme-inc, beta-shop, internal-qa). ACME has ~800.

sana: that puts acme as primary impacted. we should notify account-success. @anita can you kick off a customer advisory draft? short + apologetic + mitigation steps.

anita: will draft. also starting a canary rollback: toggling routing to redwood-neo-13b:v11 (last known-good). command: ```
redwoodctl route set /chat/completions --model redwood-neo-13b:v11 --force --reason \"eval-gate trip\"
```

jordan: routing change in progress — 5 nodes updated, 3 remaining.

incident-bot: ROUTE-UPDATE: change applied to 8/8 nodes. New traffic split: v11=100%.

mike: monitoring eval-gate signal now...

sana: ack, good. repeating eval on a small prompt set to confirm.```

mike: re-run completed — safety_score back to baseline (0.12) on canary.

sana: excellent. can we keep v11 fully live and open a rollback incident for postmortem?

jordan: logged an incident issue: https://issues.example/INC-5544. assigning to eng-ml for root cause.

anita: customer advisory draft ready in #customer-success-drafts, short note + offer to roll back any ACME jobs.

sana: nice. next steps: 1) keep v11 until root cause identified. 2) run differential eval across larger prompt corpus. 3) preserve samples and set retention. 4) coordinate postmortem with eng-ml.

mike: saving model artifacts and eval traces to s3://prod-eval-artifacts/INC-5544/

anita: pinging acct team now, flagged as high impact for ACME.

sana: thanks all. I'm closing PD-900123 (ack->resolved) since traffic is on v11 and metrics normal. leaving incident open for RCA. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty: PD-900123 status changed to RESOLVED by sana.

incident-bot: NOTE: preserve full audit logs for 30 days and add samples to the RCA ticket. tagging eng-ml, devex, and support.

sana: uploading timeline and notes to the incident ticket. will schedule RCA for tomorrow.

mike: one quick ask — add a temporary eval canary that runs extra safety checks on v12 before traffic ramp. I can implement this patch.

jordan: +1, and add an automated rollback trigger if safety_score > 0.5 on canary.

anita: thanks team. closing updates from my side. will keep customer comms on loop.

sana: closing thread here, moving the rest to the formal incident doc. great response — fast handoff and rollback prevented broader impact. :bow:
notes: auto-generated thread capture of a PagerDuty-triggered eval-gate incident and oncall mitigation; includes bot messages and commands
